stem:
Read these sentences from paragraph 7 of the story “The List.”

She had always wanted to learn to ride a unicycle and it didn’t look all that hard, so she wanted to get started with a bang. Unfortunately, the only bang was her falling off the unicycle over and over again.

Which sentence from the excerpt from Kokoro best expresses a SIMILAR idea?

options.label: A
options.text: I discovered my folly as soon as I began to work seriously. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: I was in a state of panic, and I soon rushed back to Sensei to ask what books I should read. (paragraph 2)

options.label: C
options.text: Every day, I worked as hard and as long as I could. (paragraph 9)

options.label: D
options.text: But I thought of nothing but my thesis. (paragraph 10)

visual_elements: She had always wanted to learn to ride a unicycle and it didn’t look all that hard, so she wanted to get started with a bang. Unfortunately, the only bang was her falling off the unicycle over and over again.
